name: Kled
notes: The dummy never damages Kled, so he stays Mounted for the whole fight; every Dismounted-only mechanic (the reduced attack damage to champions, the resist/movement-speed bonuses, Pocket Pistol, the ability lockouts) never triggers and is left out of this kit.

Bear Trap on a Rope is cast on cooldown: its first hit lands on cast, and the tether automatically pulls 1.75 s later for the second, larger damage instance; the pull 'recalculates dynamically based on current AD' but bonus AD does not change during a fight, so both instances are precomputed once.

Violent Tendencies is treated as already active whenever it is off cooldown (matching 'Kled periodically gains Violent Tendencies'): it grants 150% bonus attack speed until consumed. The 4th basic attack landed while it is up deals the extra physical damage as a separate instance applied before that attack's own damage (it does not trigger on-hit effects), and only then does the ability go on cooldown; every subsequent on-hit attack against the target (a champion) refunds 1.5 s of that cooldown, matching the champion refund rate.

Jousting is cast on cooldown and always recast at the minimum 0.5 s delay, landing both dash's damage instances; the cooldown starts at the first dash (no travel time is modeled) and both casts separately trigger on-cast effects.

Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is cast once at t = 0. Its collision damage scales with charge time up to a cap at 4 seconds; since the dummy fight defines no travel distance, the fully-ramped (maximum) damage tier is assumed, matching typical use of charging in from range before colliding. Its shield is ignored since it does not affect damage output, and with a 110-140 s cooldown it is never cast a second time inside the fight.
None of Kled's abilities have a listed mana cost, so mana is not modeled.
Bear Trap on a Rope's slow and Violent Tendencies' Grievous Wounds-adjacent utility do not affect a stationary dummy's damage output and are omitted.

assumed.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s collision damage ramps from a minimum to 3x that minimum over 4 seconds of charge time; against a stationary dummy with no defined travel distance, the maximum (fully-ramped) tier is assumed, matching typical use of charging in from range
